digest.component_or_area: external live test suite for Jira Cloud S3 reconciliation
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live test suite is required to validate Jira Cloud multi-project reconciliation (REB + DIG projects) against real Cloud volume and diversity, previously dropped when effort pivoted to Data Center.

The suite must structurally enforce read-only semantics by monkeypatching all 18 mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, add_label, remove_label, set_entity_property, delete_issue, transition_issue_by_name, unassign_issue, set_parent, update_priority, update_issuetype, update_comment, delete_comment, delete_issue_link) to raise JiraWriteForbidden.

The test harness uses only proven read paths: compute_snapshot for inbound fetch and bridge_preview with Mode.DRY_RUN (persist=False) for dry-run outbound, both issuing zero writes to Jira or the store.

Each test uses a fresh, isolated S3-backed store with a throwaway git remote (s3://<bucket>/<unique-prefix>), REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, deleted on teardown, ensuring no production access and minimal isolation boundary.

Per-project scenarios must validate that fetch and preview are correctly scoped to mapped projects (REB-only, DIG-only, both), with zero cross-contamination and identical before/after Jira issue counts per project.

Unknown mapped project keys must fail closed (raise) rather than silently succeed, and the CI job (jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal) must be gated on external credentials and excluded from the general external test job to prevent double-collection.
